name: 토게피
scene: At an empty white-stone garden pavilion in clear morning light, balanced upright card stance, face toward camera, both empty hands open at her sides and fully separate from the torso.
casual: Inside a sunlit hillside botanical conservatory at noon, standing and unfolding a plain illustrated trail map below her face, both hands separated at the paper edges. Cream stone arches and broad green foliage.
Opaque ivory sleeveless sailor-collar blouse with blue piping, red high-waisted tailored culottes and tan walking sandals, bare arms shoulders and legs, tiny red-blue triangle brooch.

On a dry wooden jetty at a secluded lake at golden dawn, seated comfortably on the low edge after a swim, both hands resting openly beside her hips, legs and bare feet fully visible above the clear water. Low camera, distant reeds and warm mist.

Fully lined ivory two-piece swimsuit: secure wide-strap scoop-neck top and high-waisted opaque swim briefs with full intimate coverage, tiny red and blue geometric trim. Bare shoulders arms midriff and legs, small triangle anklet.

In a bright community terrarium workshop at late afternoon, leaning lightly against a waist-high bench while placing a broad leaf onto a gravel bed inside an open glass vessel. One hand holds leaf stem, other rests open on bench, clear fingers, golden window light.

Opaque cobalt-blue sleeveless fitted wrap work top with secure neckline and white high-waisted utility trousers below crop, short red waist apron. Bare arms shoulders and narrow side-waist opening, tiny ivory triangle earrings.

comparison.scope: Latest three lifestyle plans reviewed locally; unrelated record paths and contents omitted from upload.
